scope.deadline_limit: Client stops further actions at the deadline; in-flight request/SQL cleanup and archive time can extend wall time. Timeout does not prove remote cancellation.
scope.tools: Guarded read-only SQLite queries and stored-result reads; no arbitrary execution tool.

changes: Batch supervisor finalizes and seals available trace/tool records on failure or interruption; retains all not-started slots.
Invalid model actions end their own trajectory without syntax repair or replacement.
Readonly SQL child now explicitly uses -B, preventing bytecode writes into frozen source, and hides its Windows console. Historical frozen source trees were not changed.
Prospective final-answer policy separates human answer review from trace diagnostics, and cannot infer C-type drift from an unelicited workflow.

validation.test_scope: Scripted generators/transports, temporary SQLite fixtures and offline source/input/tokenizer checks. Not research observations.

remaining: Fresh user approval and confirmation of sufficient current balance.
User enters the key hidden in their own terminal after approval; do not reuse chat credentials.
After execution, audit full raw records and export condition-hidden final-answer review packets. No final-answer semantic labels before actual independent review.
Public GitHub push awaits the user's configured proxy/authentication; raw records remain private.
